summary: Sporting News previews FanDuel's Swift-themed "Prop Stars" prop bets for the Week 4 Sunday Night Football game between the Chiefs and Jets at MetLife Stadium, where Taylor Swift is expected to appear with Travis Kelce. Writer Nick Brinkerhoff rates each of nine props, passing on most and backing three: Kelce first TD scorer, Kelce 3+ TDs (small wager), and Jets scoring 0 points (small wager). The piece mixes betting analysis with Swift song-title jokes and commentary on the Jets' offense under Zach Wilson.
one_line: Sporting News rates FanDuel's Taylor Swift-themed Prop Stars bets for Chiefs-Jets Week 4, backing Kelce first TD and two small long shots.
key_facts: FanDuel released a special prop bets menu called "Prop Stars" with Taylor Swift-inspired wagers for the Chiefs-Jets Sunday Night Football game in Week 4.
The author passes on Travis Kelce to have the most receiving yards (+140) because of blowout potential in the game.
The Jets are giving up the fifth-most receiving yards to tight ends this season (56.3) and allowed Pharoah Brown a 58-yard touchdown the previous Sunday.
The author passes on Chiefs to win by 22+ (+380), noting the Jets often keep games close and a garbage-time score would ruin the bet.
Travis Kelce First TD Scorer (+400) is the author's favorite special, with the pick "Bet on it"; the reasoning is that Zach Wilson has become "Checkdown Charlie" under conservative coaching.
The author passes on Chiefs 150+ total rushing yards (+420), Kelce last TD scorer (+550), Kelce to NOT score a TD (+120), and Zach Wilson 300+ passing yards (+1800).
Kelce to score 3+ TDs (+2500) gets a "Bet on it (with a small wager)" pick; the author projects Kelce for one touchdown and notes he prefers division rivals like the Raiders and Chargers.
NY Jets to score 0 total points (+3400) is also a small-wager pick, citing an improved Chiefs defense and a Jets team that "doesn’t have a quarterback."
The game was expected to feature Aaron Rodgers against Patrick Mahomes, but Rodgers is out and Zach Wilson is the Jets' quarterback.
Kelce hosted "Saturday Night Live" in March, which the author cites as evidence he knows how to tell a story.
Chris 'Mad Dog' Russo's rant is cited as among the most vocal fatigue over the Kelce-Swift coverage.
Mahomes is playing in the New York area for the first time in this game, per the author.
